description: Price a framed print: unit price, subtotal, shipping, and total before tax, with a summary of the store policies. Ships to the US only; tax is calculated by Stripe at checkout.

frame.description: frame_id from get_print_options. Default: the work's default frame

ship_to.description: Optional. Checks that we ship there.

country.description: ISO country code. Only US is accepted.

size.description: size_id from get_print_options, or Small, Medium, Large. Default: the site default (Large when the scan allows)

work.description: Prefer ascii_id (the slug) from search_works or get_work; the id with or without its en dash, a /w/ URL, exact title, accession, or NASA ID also work

name: quote_order
title: Quote order
